# devopser_github_app_installation (Data Source)

The organization's DevOpser GitHub App installation, by GitHub account (tfe_github_app_installation).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "devopser_github_app_installation" "gh" {
  name = "my-github-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) GitHub account (owner) name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The installation id, as a string.
- `installation_id` (Number) The GitHub App installation id.
